relations.note: The Spirit manifests Barbelo as its first self-disclosure, image, glory, and womb.
The Spirit grants the aeonic powers requested by Barbelo after she contemplates and praises it.
The Spirit’s light shines upon Barbelo, through whom the divine Child emerges nonsexually.
Foreknowledge appears at Barbelo’s request and praises the Spirit and Barbelo.
Incorruptibility appears at Barbelo’s request and praises the Spirit and Barbelo.
Eternal Life appears at Barbelo’s request and praises the Spirit and Barbelo.
Truth appears at Barbelo’s request and praises the Spirit and Barbelo.
Autogenes emerges through the Spirit’s light and Barbelo’s activity.
The Spirit perfects and anoints Autogenes with goodness or divine power.
The Spirit places Autogenes over the divine Fullness.
Harmozel stands before the Spirit and participates in ordering the aeonic habitations.
Oroiael stands before the Spirit and participates in ordering the aeonic habitations.
Daveithai stands before the Spirit and participates in ordering the aeonic habitations.
Eleleth stands before the Spirit and participates in ordering the aeonic habitations.
relations.source: Apocryphon of John; Hypostasis of the Archons

relations.note: Sophia belongs to the aeonic order ultimately derived from the Spirit, though no direct encounter occurs.
The Spirit is the remote source above Yaldabaoth, not his immediate biological parent.
A voice from the higher realm refutes Yaldabaoth’s claim to be the sole god.
relations.source: Apocryphon of John; Hypostasis of the Archons

relations.note: Heavenly Adamas exists as an image connected with the Spirit and reflected to the lower rulers.

relations.myth: Great Seth and the incorruptible race
relations.note: Great Seth serves the Spirit’s divine plan by establishing the incorruptible race and baptism.
relations.source: Holy Book of the Great Invisible Spirit

relations.note: Protennoia acts as the hidden Spirit’s self-expression, descending as Thought, Voice, and Word.
The Triple-Powered One is variously the Spirit’s potency, immediate hypostasis, or the Spirit itself.
Living Silence is associated with the unknown Father as the condition from which triadic powers emerge.
relations.source: Holy Book of the Great Invisible Spirit

relations.note: The triadic powers come forth from living Silence and praise the Great Invisible Spirit.
relations.source: Holy Book of the Great Invisible Spirit

relations.note: Youel mediates knowledge of the Triple-Powered One and unknowable Spirit to Allogenes.
Allogenes approaches the Spirit through mediated instruction, abstraction, and unknowing rather than direct conversation.
Zostrianos ascends through baptisms and revelations toward the Triple-Powered Invisible Spirit.
